reading_note: The arc traces the complete circuit (twelve = full zodiac of spiritual states) by which Divine Truth proceeding from the hidden Father (Divine Love itself) discriminates good from evil across every discrete degree of being. The single judge "set over all judges" is the Lord's own Truth; from Him proceed twelve operations of discrimination, descending from the inmost (First Man = Divine Truth entering self-love's domain) through the operative power that builds spiritual order (Living Spirit), the matrix that gives spiritual birth (Mother of Life), the founding governance fixed in the highest heavens (King of Honor in the seventh firmament), the awakening call (Third Ambassador), the rescuing Truth descending to ultimates (Jesus the Splendour), the pure receptive faculty (Virgin of Light), the discrimination operating in the natural-rational sphere (judge in the air), the celestial-degree reception (Mind of Light), and finally the Great Counsel (Call and Hearing together) — the last judgment that separates good from evil, gathers itself wholly into the Lord, and depicts Him alone at the consummation. The whole teaches: every degree of judgment in the spiritual world is one continuous act of the Divine Human discriminating what is His own from what is not.
